integrity: The proof is a symbolic reduction plus exhaustive exact finite evaluation; direct three-round game comparisons independently corroborate the representative separation. This is not independent external validation.
scientific_limitations: Only nonempty finite star forests in pure undirected graph vocabulary.
Rank exactly bounded by three; the 255-case computation is connected to the full infinite domain by a symbolic Ehrenfeucht–Fraisse reduction.
Related or equivalent results may exist in unindexed work.
title: Twenty-two rank-three first-order theories of finite star forests
